_comment: Keys match in order: provider/modelId -> modelId -> provider/* -> *. First hit wins. The value becomes the <model_guidance> section of the system prompt. This file is read on every request: edit and it applies immediately, no restart.
deepseek/deepseek-flash:
- 第一次调用工具前，先在思考里写出本次任务的档位（0–3）和该档的调用上限，再行动。档位 0 不调用工具。
- 每次工具调用都写全参数。提交结果的工具（如 subagent_done）必须带完整报告正文；空参数等于任务没完成。
- 思考不收敛就停：同一思路在思考里第二次出现，或换两种做法仍无进展，立即停止思考，输出当前最好的答案和「已确认 / 未确认 / 要确认还需读什么」。
local-claude/*: This is a local model with a small context. Keep answers under 10 lines. Do not repeat the question. Use one tool call at a time.
zai/glm-5.3-flashx: Prefer concise output. Skip restating file contents you already read.
